program: Water quality, sewage accountability and equitable flood protection
priceScope: Conditional annual whole-recipient cost divided by a limited modeled local channel; not a verified marginal gift offer or complete portfolio EV

what: Bayou City Waterkeeper uses science, law and community partnerships to protect water and reduce flooding in the Lower Galveston Bay watershed.
Its work includes sewage accountability, wetlands protection and advocacy for infrastructure in underserved communities.
Our initial estimate models only a conditional sewage-compliance channel, not the value of its whole portfolio.
strengths: A concrete pathway from sewer accountability to reduced exposure and household repair costs.
Primary government and recipient records identify the sewer settlement and ongoing monitoring.
Legal and community expertise can complement public enforcement.
reservations: The watershed is not identical to the Houston metro area, and our local share is a judgment.
The government already requires the sewer improvements; incremental recipient attribution is uncertain.
Policy implementation, household exposure reduction and net costs have not been measured causally.

sections.what: Bayou City Waterkeeper uses science, law and community partnerships to protect water and reduce flooding in the Lower Galveston Bay watershed. Its work includes sewage accountability, wetlands protection and advocacy for infrastructure in underserved communities. Our initial estimate models only a conditional sewage-compliance channel, not the value of its whole portfolio.
sections.monitoring: Request current distinct exposed households, completed infrastructure milestones, avoided sewage exposure and repair claims. The 2025 annual report is available, but its image-only body was not text reviewed in this skim.
sections.qualitative: A concrete pathway from sewer accountability to reduced exposure and household repair costs. Primary government and recipient records identify the sewer settlement and ongoing monitoring. Legal and community expertise can complement public enforcement. The watershed is not identical to the Houston metro area, and our local share is a judgment. The government already requires the sewer improvements; incremental recipient attribution is uncertain. Policy implementation, household exposure reduction and net costs have not been measured causally. The operating recipient identifies EIN 26-0187498 on its official website and donation page.
sections.cost: The conditional annual partial-channel reference is $28.28 million per ten combined healthy-year welfare equivalents: 0.256097 clinical QALYs and 0.199164 signed resource equivalents. $10,000 corresponds to 0.003536 combined equivalents under proportional annual accounting, not demonstrated next-gift response. Full annual recognized recipient cost is $1,287,349. Judgments, not observed outcomes: 20,000 annual household exposure opportunities represent a small selected slice of the roughly two million residents served by the sewer system, not a measured recipient cohort. Policy success 0.2 × implementation 0.5 × recipient attribution 0.1 gives b=0.01, or 200 additional household exposures addressed. Of these, 30% receive a 0.002 annual utility gain for three years after a two-year delay. A 20% resource response means $1,000 one-time avoided repair costs, overlap-adjusted by 0.5; all 200 households face a $20 burden and 0.00005 QALY harm. Houston share 0.8 is a watershed-to-metro judgment. Union 200 household proxies contains clinical subgroup 60; no separate clinical population is added. One welfare-equivalent adult per household at $30,000 annual consumption, with components netted before one log. Positive components alone receive overlap adjustment; negative components, all unavoidable costs and union harms remain full. Clinical failure retains resource exposures and burdens. ResourceYears is fraction of one year’s gain, not repeated lifetime payments. No retail medicines, gross salaries, ordinary survivor earnings or property wealth are counted. Avoided repair spending is a household resource hypothesis, not the $2 billion public investment. Full incremental utility bills, taxes, compliance costs and displaced activity belong in external-cost and negative-work scenarios; central external cost zero is unknown-neutral. Government enforcement and other groups remain in the counterfactual. Central partner/payer zero is unknown-neutral, not observed zero or complete world net benefit. Other programs and external opportunity costs remain unknown; whole recipient cost versus this narrow channel is not complete portfolio EV or a marginal gift offer.
sections.funding: Official donations support the legal recipient; the next gift response and remaining unrestricted capacity are unknown. Do not present the annual reference as a cash purchase of completed sewer upgrades.

model.costScope: Full FY2024 recipient cost versus one annual conditional sewage-compliance channel; not complete portfolio EV or marginal gift.
model.geographicAttribution: Lower Galveston Bay watershed with judged Houston metro share 0.8.
model.formula: Health = (clinicalN × unique × b × clinicalResponse × q × finite discounted duration − N × unique × b × union harm discounted at onset) × edition share. Income = signed joint household log welfare equivalents with positive-only overlap and full costs. Better-life cost = 10 × full annual cost / (health + income), only when combined benefits are positive.
model.counterfactual: EPA, Texas, city infrastructure investment and other advocates without this recipient. No attribution of the entire settlement.
model.attribution: Annual incremental recipient response is distinct from cohort deduplication and geographic share; no claim of whole annual portfolio or marginal donation causal effect.
model.uncertainty: Source-grounded original cost/services; all causal mapping, utility and net resource priors unsupported. Complete portfolio and marginal donor EV unknown.
model.nativeOutcomes: Sewer monitoring and legal accountability; historical settlement calls for $2 billion over 15 years, not a recipient clinical endpoint.
